content_of_post_to_answer: Does performing your job in the same rooms where you relax make it harder to switch off from work mode at the end of the day?
answer: Yes, and the reason is less about the room itself and more about the lack of a psychological boundary. A workplace gives the brain cues that work has ended; when the same chair, desk, or corner holds both deadlines and rest, those signals become blurred. The overlooked tradeoff is convenience versus separation: a home office can create distance from work, but a work corner inside your living space can quietly make your entire home feel like an office.
